But during install, when the module `openculturas_openstreetmap` is being installed, the `geocoder` module must be enabled first. But looking at the install order, geocoder was never installed before the failure. Actually the issue is the config import installs all modules in one batch — and Drupal's config import processes module installs, but at some point it rebuilds the container. The openstreetmap module's service is defined with autowire and references geocoder.throttle. If geocoder module isn't enabled yet when openculturas_openstreetmap is installed, container compilation fails.
